facts.activity_file: controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas

control_failures.control_label: authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: near hit during start-up after maintenance on TX-3001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HOT_WORK_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on TX-3001 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining hazardous-area electrical equipment, specifically controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas. TX-3001 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant had been bypassed. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 23 July 2009 a near hit was recorded on TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
